name: cannavec-science
description: Elite-tier cannabis-science plugin for the working researcher. Five commands, eight curated science registries with freshness watch (major + minor cannabinoids incl. Δ⁸-THC/HHC/THCO/THCP, terpenes, drug interactions, adverse events, populations, contraindications, pharmacogenomics), seven phytochemistry rigor detectors (isomer-collapse, receptor-without-ID, dose-without-route, THCA-vs-THC conflation, matrix-unit confusion, decarb-context-missing, entourage-overclaim), 15 banned-pattern detector, safety preflight, retraction enforcement at composition time, live discovery across eleven primary-source databases — PubMed, ChEMBL, ClinicalTrials.gov, PubChem, PharmGKB, RCSB PDB, Open Targets, GWAS Catalog, BindingDB, bioRxiv, medRxiv — with deterministic cross-source synthesis, citation-network forward-pushback analysis, researcher-workflow scaffolders (PICO, sample-size / power calculation, GRADE evidence-profile table, IRB protocol skeleton), regulatory-feasibility advisory (US / EU / Canada / UK), endocannabinoidome reference, BibTeX/RIS/CSL-JSON bibliography export with inline GRADE annotation, registry-freshness probe, and a cannabis-primary-source-routing skill that picks the right database per question. Researcher audience only. Stdlib-only Python ≥ 3.9. The disciplined-MVP distillation of the 35,500-LOC Cannavec parent plugin, rebuilt for elite working-scientist use.
